description: This file defines configuration options for stream cache eviction and stream statistics within the Orleans streaming framework. It introduces classes with properties that control cache timing behaviors and statistics monitoring intervals.

classes.name: StreamCacheEvictionOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration settings related to cache eviction timing for stream messages and metadata in Orleans.

classes.name: StreamStatisticOptions
classes.description: Contains configuration settings for stream statistics monitoring intervals in Orleans.

methods.name: DefaultDataMinTimeInCache
methods.description: Default minimum duration a data message stays in cache (5 minutes).

methods.name: DefaultDataMaxAgeInCache
methods.description: Default maximum age difference allowed for messages in cache (30 minutes).

methods.name: DefaultMetadataMinTimeInCache
methods.description: Default minimum duration metadata stays in cache, calculated as twice the DataMinTimeInCache.

methods.name: DefaultStatisticMonitorWriteInterval
methods.description: Default interval at which stream statistics are monitored (5 minutes).
